behavior: Official native clips play when available. Until native media is ready, missing cues remain silent. Native module-import failure never decodes the generic legacy bank. No synthesized oscillator, generated noise loop or fanfare is used for either selected game. A missing selected native Bet or win-tier clip is not replaced by another clip.
timing: Foxy movement starts only for an unfinished active spin at its elapsed one-shot offset. No duplicate adoption, expired clip restart, or playback during stop/mute/hidden/disposed states. MH5 retains no moving-reel cue.

cases: events before delayed decode create zero oscillator/noise buffers and zero source nodes
late Foxy decode adopts elapsed offset once
late decode after stop/mute/hidden/disposal cannot start
hidden time excluded and expired one-shot cannot restart
native codec failure remains silent and does not reject events
native source-node construction failure cannot create fallback noise
missing MH5 Bet cannot become Tap and missing win tier cannot become another tier
source media hashes, native gain graph and audio controls remain validated

readiness: Existing YES/unlock path already preloads native banks asynchronously. Gameplay does not wait for browser audio permission or decoding.
